name: Snow Queen 3
author: Addicting Games
description: Snow Queen 3 is a unique matching game that requires strategic thinking! The Snow Queen is back in the third installment of this matching series. She has once again frozen everything and the elves are trapped! It is up to you to match together the stones to free different elements in order to break the spell. While other matching games require senseless matching, this online game has goals that you must reach to pass each level. For instance, in the first level, you must set free all the pieces of a butterfly in order to win that level. Watch the timer because if you run out of time, you lose the level. There are 25 levels of this adventurous matching game for you to solve in order to defeat the snow queen!
